items.title: Sheafifying the presheaf of cohomology groups of an object recovers its cohomology sheaf
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the sheafification of the presheaf U -> H^q(U, K) with the cohomology sheaf H^q(K) (statement lines 4348-4356). The proof is a short but genuine computation: after rewriting H^q(U, K) through the localized site, one chooses a K-injective representative I^bullet so that the presheaf becomes the presheaf of kernels modulo images of the section complex, which is exactly the presheaf of sections of the cohomology sheaf H^q(K), so its sheafification is H^q(K) (proof lines 4359-4370). The claim is H2: one representative choice and one comparison of presheaves.
